answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Work waits on the opal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the delta of the next round. By the ledge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
